question_text: The distance from $\text{P}(k, 6, -5)$ to $\text{Q}(2, -1, -8)$ is 9 units. Find the possible values of $k$.

subparts.stem: The distance from $\text{P}(k, 6, -5)$ to $\text{Q}(2, -1, -8)$ is 9 units. Find the possible values of $k$.
subparts.solution: 26 is the data value which occurs most often, so the mode is 26 customers.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a dataset.
step_by_step: Inspect the data set for the most frequent number.
26 appears twice, while all other numbers appear once.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Missing repeated values or reporting the frequency instead of the value.
